author: Bobby Grayson
message:
shoehorn: exact-VRAM-fit imatrix quantizer for GGUF models

Own Rust implementations of ggml block formats (Q4_0/1, Q5_0/1, Q8_0,
Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K) with imatrix-weighted scale search; Lagrangian knapsack
solver picks a per-tensor mix landing within ~100KB of the Metal
working-set budget; llama.cpp runs the result.

Validated on Qwen3-0.6B: 99.98% budget utilization, +0.6% held-out PPL
at 46% of BF16 size, 210 tok/s on M4 Pro.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
